levels.surface: هارون بن زيد بن أبي الزرقاء

notes: «حدثنا أبي» : the father of Haroun is named only by relation, so a relation link (the second standalone «أبي» in the text)
«عن أبي حازم، وزيد بن أسلم، أن أم الدرداء» : the two are one level and «أم الدرداء» is the next link
the last link is Abu al-Darda's own report of the Prophet's words; the Prophet is not a link
